# Puerto Plata SEO

> Puerto Plata SEO (puertoplataseo.com) helps businesses on the Dominican Republic's north coast (Puerto Plata, Sosúa, Cabarete) get found on Google and in AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity. It serves hotels, restaurants, real estate and local services. Bilingual (Spanish and English).

## Pages
- [Home](https://puertoplataseo.com/): SEO, AI search optimization (AIO), services, barter options, service areas and FAQ
- [SEO en Puerto Plata: guía para negocios locales](https://puertoplataseo.com/guia-seo-puerto-plata/): Perfil de Empresa, web bilingüe, páginas por zona, reseñas y búsqueda con IA, con datos de MITUR, Banco Central y StatCounter (español)

## Related sites in the Dominican Republic
- [SEO Dominican Republic](https://seodominicanrepublic.com/): national Dominican Republic coverage

## Key facts
- Run by Eye To Ad Media, a digital marketing agency headquartered in Denver, Colorado, in business since 2012
- No ranking guarantees; clients own their domain, website, Google Business Profile and ad accounts
- Contact: 1-800-481-8638 (toll-free), WhatsApp +1 720-249-6588, info@eyetoad.com, or the form at https://puertoplataseo.com/
